        "Read full nine-path364-line owned diff and changed test/helper contracts. Production fix removes direct mCopyServiceListener OnStopCopy from EWS OnCopyCompleted while keeping notifications and delegating to copyService.NotifyCompletion. Actual copy service finds matching original request, checks processing/failure, calls ClearRequest and that method calls listener before removal. This is scoped ownership of tracked request completion, not a blanket guarantee every call or every listener runs exactly once under every invalid/reentrant state.",

Shared helper is moved from IMAP test unchanged and resolves on any STATE_STOP without status checking/rejection. Count assertion is separate; neither task directly clicks a DOM Save button, counts completion callbacks, resaves/replaces a draft or proves saved body fidelity. Three changed assertions have nonempty expected messages.",
        "Fake CreateItem support allocates created-item IDs and populates target folder before returning ID; initial helper passes no supplied synthetic content, so do not infer full MIME persistence from one count. setupBasicEwsTestServer centralizes existing profile/server/cleanup setup, and default fake version uses nullish default Exchange2013; current test later also dispatches Graph. Keep original/current phases separate. Existing new-draft key lessons are related but not repeated. No save, compose, IMAP, server or test ran.",
        "Full primary Bug1978685 description/comments0–2/footer and D258643 creation-to-commit timeline plus four actual inlineThreads read; no summary histories. Report distinguishes close-window Save working from compose Save button failure followed by silent close/data loss. Reviewer describes hidden copy-service ownership, asks corrected comment method name and regression test. Actual source removes direct OnStopCopy and corrects comment OnCopyComplete to OnStopCopy, with exact owner/caller proof already retained.",
        "Author reports new test fails without fix on same double-OnStopCopy path but different surrounding app symptoms; historical report is separate from direct assertions. Test does not click Save button or count callbacks; it awaits stop-state adapter and asserts Drafts count1. Two Try reports/links are retained unopened and not fresh execution.",

After successful envelope parse/version handling it checks only response_messages().first() for Error with typed MessageXml::ServerBusy, sleeps supplied milliseconds and retries the whole operation. Existing whole-request SOAP fault backoff remains. Nonfirst busy messages are not separately scanned by this gate. Title all responses means generic operation coverage, not every message or arbitrary error retry. Retry count/delay caps, cancellation, idempotence and every server are not established by this patch/read.",

Current macro later uses NAME constants, while historical generated name methods are kept distinct.",

Iterator Result collection returns first error and drops partial accumulated successes, replacing earlier filter_map that logged/skipped per-message errors. Warnings still log then count as success. This is callback/result behavior, not proof server changes are rolled back. Create/delete/update single-response callers switch strict length validation to single_response_or_error: zero errors, multiple warns and uses first. Preserve this separate count-policy change; do not silently describe it as equivalent.",

Focused knowledge lookup found only source navigation maps for this contract, not an equivalent focused supported lesson to duplicate. Actual historical and accepted source inspect first only; all Done labels/approval do not settle mixed-response correctness or idempotence.
